direct_enterprise.assumptions: UNVERIFIED 60-month partner/service hypothesis. Opening capital exactly USD100000; no initial customers, no funding injection. Net settlement processor fees; conservative 25% cash-receipt tax/levy proxy in addition to fees and incurred complete work/support/acquisition/capacity costs. Projections not observed market contracts. Customer qualification/participation, partner reach, acceptance, repeat purchase, payment, capacity and modeled host costs are author priors. Historical 14-day low-ticket native business is a source-bound financial/technical anchor ONLY; its limited buyer/WTP cannot validate these scale premises. No deposit/loan or equity funding. No external transaction.
